overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Kronenwetter Board was scheduled to convene on August 10, 2026, to address staff reports, consider an Oak Wilt Ordinance, and vote on a temporary moratorium on new data center development applications. The data center moratorium was set for referral to planning and utility committees for further study.

agenda.item: Revaluation Update Report from Village Assessor
Finance Director Report – Preliminary Equalized Valuation & TID Increments
Resolution 2026-011 Establishing a Temporary Moratorium on New Data Center Development Applications and Referring the Matter to the Planning and Utility Committees for Further Study (CLIPP)

discussions.body: The Board was scheduled to discuss and consider action on an Oak Wilt Ordinance. This item was marked for discussion and possible action but no additional details regarding the ordinance provisions were included on the agenda.

discussions.item: Resolution 2026-011 Temporary Moratorium on Data Center Development
discussions.body: The Board was set to consider Resolution 2026-011, which was scheduled to establish a temporary moratorium on new data center development applications in the village. The resolution was expected to include a referral to the Planning and Utility Committees for further study of data center development issues.

The Finance Director was scheduled to present a report on preliminary equalized valuation and Tax Increment District increments. This report was set for Board review but no specific details about valuations or TID districts were provided on the agenda.
The Village Assessor was scheduled to provide an update on the ongoing revaluation process. The specific scope and status of the revaluation were not detailed on the agenda.

publicComment: Public comment was on the agenda, limited to 15 minutes total with three minutes per person, subject to extension at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion.

title: Village Board Meeting - 2026-08-10
